# Deck

## What the cards share

Every card is a Titan Warrior with a spear, and Blood Hunt is its damage: it lunges at a bleeding enemy and consumes its Blood Loss for a burst of physical damage. Bloodlust and Brutality I support it.

## How they differ

Six engines: bleed from on-hit (4), bleed from on-crit (1), bleed from weapon-slot (1), bleed from armour-break (1), bleed from on-block (1) and rage from on-hit (1); where the bleed comes from sets each card's weapon and defence.

## Round 1

- r1-a-1 "Blood Hunt bleed burst" | one lunge spends the bleed you built for a big hit, so rares melt in two presses | engine: bleed from on-hit
- r1-a-2 "Blood Hunt with Rolling Slam clear" | Rolling Slam clears the packs and Blood Hunt finishes the rares, so each button has one job | engine: bleed from on-hit
- r1-a-3 "Blood Hunt crit lunge" | critical hits stack the bleed faster, so the burst comes sooner | engine: bleed from on-crit | under-played (judgment: a crit-and-bleed shape, rarely built on a spear lunge)
- r1-b-1 "Blood Hunt on a two-hander" | a two-handed spear's bigger hit makes every lunge count | engine: bleed from on-hit
- r1-b-2 "Blood Hunt with a bleed unique" | a unique spear that adds bleed makes the burst bigger from the first hit | engine: bleed from weapon-slot | can't be finalized yet: its spear isn't in the PoB pin | waits on the pin: Crimson Test Spear
- r1-b-3 "Blood Hunt armour stacker" | stacked armour shrugs off the hits that kill most melee builds, and Blood Hunt still bursts | engine: bleed from on-hit | under-played (judgment: an armour-stacking shape, rarely paired with a spear lunge)
- r1-c-1 "Blood Hunt with Titan slam notables" | Titan's slam notables make every hit heavier, so the lunge and the slam both grow | engine: bleed from armour-break
- r1-c-2 "Blood Hunt block tank" | block stops most hits outright, so the lunge can go in deeper | engine: bleed from on-block | under-played (judgment: a block shape few spear builds take)
- r1-c-3 "Blood Hunt rage cycling" | rage builds while you fight and spends itself on bigger lunges | engine: rage from on-hit

## Not dealt

None.

## Found, not used

- Herald of Blood as the main clear: no card leads packs with it, since its explosions need a bleeding kill first.
